title: Zoho CRM vs HubSpot for Indian SMEs
verdict: Choose Zoho CRM for cost-conscious sales teams, deep customisation and the wider Zoho suite. Choose HubSpot when inbound marketing, ease of adoption and polished reporting matter more than per-seat cost.
seoTitle: Zoho CRM vs HubSpot for Indian SMEs (2026)
seoDescription: Zoho CRM or HubSpot for an Indian SME: pricing model, ease of use, WhatsApp and Tally integration, marketing features and when custom CRM wins.
summary: Zoho CRM is affordable per user, highly configurable and part of a large suite including Books, Desk and Inventory. HubSpot is known for ease of use and strong marketing tools, with a generous free tier but costs that rise quickly on higher plans. Indian SMEs on a budget often choose Zoho; marketing-led teams often prefer HubSpot.

dataPoints.label: Pricing model
dataPoints.value: Both charge per user on paid plans; HubSpot's higher tiers cost considerably more

dataPoints.label: Ease of use
dataPoints.value: HubSpot is usually quicker to adopt; Zoho is more configurable

dataPoints.label: Marketing
dataPoints.value: HubSpot's marketing hub is stronger; Zoho offers Campaigns and Marketing Automation

dataPoints.label: Indian integrations
dataPoints.value: Both connect to WhatsApp providers, IndiaMART and payment gateways through apps or APIs

dataPoints.label: Ecosystem
dataPoints.value: Zoho One bundles many business apps; HubSpot integrates widely with third-party tools

body:
## When neither fits

If your sales process involves quotations with complex pricing, dealer hierarchies or project tracking, a custom CRM or heavy customisation may fit better. See [custom CRM vs Zoho vs HubSpot](/blog/custom-crm-vs-zoho-vs-hubspot-for-indian-smes) and the [CRM cost guide](/cost/crm-software).

## Integrations to check

- [IndiaMART to Zoho CRM](/integrations/indiamart-zoho-crm)
- [HubSpot and WhatsApp](/integrations/hubspot-whatsapp)
- [Tally and HubSpot](/integrations/tally-hubspot)

Prices and features change often; check current details before deciding.

faqs.q: Can we migrate from one to the other later?
faqs.a: Yes. Contacts, deals and activities migrate with planning; custom fields need mapping.
Both need a connector or custom integration; neither connects to Tally natively.
